blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Symptom networks in psychopathology are estimated almost exclusively from self-report questionnaires, restricting inference to whatever symptom set a given instrument covers. We introduce a framework for symptom-resolved network estimation directly from social media discourse and apply the framework to depression and eating disorders, with a third anorexia corpus as cross-dataset validation. To our knowledge, we are the first to estimate symptom-resolved psychometric networks from social media text, compare them to clinical co-endorsement networks, and replicate transdiagnostic linguistic markers across 3 independently recruited corpora spanning 2 disorders simultaneously. For depression, expression scores correlate with BDI-II totals at $ρ{=}0.434$, 20 of 21 items reach FDR significance, and split-half reliability is 0.935. The Network Comparison Test detects few edge differences between modalities (3-5\% of edges), while bridge symptoms diverge. For eating disorders, the item-level results are exploratory. Identified linguistic features replicate the same direction across all 3 corpora, and they cluster in three construct families.
blocks.zh: 精神病学中的症状网络几乎完全从自我报告调查表中估算出来,这限制了对某一仪器所覆盖的症状的推断。 我们引入一个直接从社交媒体言论中解答症状的网络估计框架,并将框架应用于抑郁症和饮食障碍,第三个厌食症作为跨数据集验证. 据我们所知,我们是第一个从社交媒体文本中估算症状解开的心理测量网络,将它们与临床共同认可网络进行比较,并在独立招募的3个同时横穿2个障碍的蝎子身上复制转诊语言标记。 对于抑郁症,表达分数与BDI-II合计数相挂钩,为0.434美元,21项中有20项达到FDR意义,而分出半可靠性为0.935. 网络比较 测试检测到模式之间的边缘差异很少(边缘为3-5\%),而桥梁症状则有所不同. 对于饮食障碍,项目级结果为探索性. 识别出的语言特征在所有3个蝎子身上复制出相同的方向,它们聚集在三个构造家族中.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Network psychometrics treat mental disorders as patterns of interacting symptoms ( Borsboom, 2017 ; Robinaugh et al., 2020 ) , with bridge symptoms as candidate targets for transdiagnostic intervention ( Jones et al., 2021 ) . The framework has been productive but relies almost entirely on self-report questionnaires. Fried (2017) documents 52 depression symptoms across seven scales with a mean overlap of 0.36; which nodes appear, and which emerge as bridges, depends on the symptoms the instrument uses.
blocks.zh: 网络心理计量学将精神障碍视为相互作用症状的规律(Borsboom, 2017;Robinaugh等人, 2020),桥梁症状作为转诊干预的候选目标(Jones等人, 2021). 该框架富有成效,但几乎完全依靠自报调查表。 Fried (2017)记录了横跨7个尺度的52个抑郁症症状,平均重叠0.36;这些节点出现,并作为桥梁出现,取决于仪器使用的症状.

blocks.en: To our knowledge, this is the first symptom-resolved psychometric network estimated from naturalistic text and the first comparison of clinical and linguistic symptom networks within the same instrument frame. A two-stage bi-encoder cascade scores each user against each questionnaire item, and the resulting per-user, per-symptom matrix feeds Gaussian Graphical Model estimation. We apply the framework across two eRisk corpora (depression as the main finding, eating disorders as exploratory), with additional analyses on a third (anorexia). The methodological contribution lies not in the retrieval architecture, adapted from existing eRisk systems, but in estimating item-resolved symptom networks from that output and comparing them formally to questionnaire-based networks via the Network Comparison Test. Symptoms surface in text either explicitly ("I haven’t enjoyed anything in weeks") or through emotional tone and word choice; we use retrieval for the first and LIWC-22 ( Boyd et al., 2022 ) with pretrained emotion classifiers for the second.
blocks.zh: 据我们所知,这是第一个从自然主义文本中估计的症状和解心理测量网络,也是在同一仪器框架内对临床和语言症状网络的第一次比较。 一个两阶段双编码器级联对每个用户的每个问卷项目进行评分,由此得出的每个用户的每个症状矩阵为高斯图形模型估计提供了依据。 我们在两个eRisk corpora(抑制为主要发现,食用失调为探索性)中应用这个框架,对第三个(亚诺雷克夏)进行补充分析. 方法上的贡献不在于从现有eRisk系统改编的检索结构,而在于从该产出中估计物品解症网络,并通过网络比较测试正式将其与基于问卷的网络进行比较。 或通过情感语气和文字选择; 我们使用检索来获取第一种和LIWC-22(Boyd等人, 2022年),

blocks.en: We address two questions. RQ1 : Do networks estimated from per-user, per-symptom scores produced by a retrieval pipeline for social media posts resemble questionnaire-based networks? RQ2 : Are there linguistic features that separate symptomatic from non-symptomatic users consistently across disorders and recruitment frames?
blocks.zh: 我们处理两个问题。 RQ1 : (英语). 从社交媒体帖子检索管道产生的每个用户、每个症状的分数估计的网络是否类似于基于问卷的网络? RQ2 : (英语). 是否有语言特征将症状使用者与非症状使用者在各种障碍和招聘框架之间一致区分开来?

blocks.en: Our contributions are: (1) a comparison of clinical and linguistic symptom networks using the Network Comparison Test, (2) a cross-disorder taxonomy of several replicating linguistic features, and (3) a reproduced state-of-the-art framework for symptom retrieval with an added first-person filter.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献是:(1) 利用网络比较测试来比较临床和语言症状网络,(2) 几种复制语言特征的交叉失调分类学,以及(3) 复制的具有第一人称过滤器的症状检索最新框架。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: In psychopathology network models, nodes are symptoms and edges are partial correlations after conditioning on all other symptoms. The standard estimator is the Gaussian Graphical Model (GGM) with EBIC-tuned graphical LASSO ( Epskamp and Fried, 2018 ) , yielding edge weights, centrality (Expected Influence), community structure, and bridge symptoms ( Jones et al., 2021 ) ; stability is assessed via case-dropping bootstraps and the CS-coefficient ( Epskamp et al., 2018 ) .
blocks.zh: 在精神病学网络模型中,节点是症状,边缘在对所有其他症状进行调节后是局部的关联. 标准估计器是高斯图形模型(GGM),带有EBIC调图的图形LASSO(Epskamp和Fried,2018年),产生边缘重量,中心作用(expected impact),社区结构,桥梁症状(Jones等人,2021年);稳定性通过案例掉靴子和CS协同效应(Epskamp等人,2018年)来评估.

blocks.en: Bi-encoder retrieval ( Karpukhin et al., 2020 ) is a standard Information Retrieval (IR) architecture, applied to mental health symptom retrieval such as the eRisk shared task ( Parapar et al., 2024 ) . Elevated first-person pronoun use reliably correlates with depression severity ( Rude et al., 2004 ; Tackman et al., 2019 ) ; lower analytic thinking with psychological distress ( Corbin et al., 2023 ) ; and eating-disorder communities show identifiable lexical profiles ( Chancellor et al., 2016 ) . Pretrained emotion classifiers ( Demszky et al., 2020 ; Hartmann, 2022 ) produce post-level emotion distributions complementary to fixed lexicons; whether they add signal beyond LIWC in symptom-network analyses has not been tested until now.
blocks.zh: Bi-encoder reference(Karpukhin等人,2020年)是一个标准的信息检索(IR)架构,应用于eRisk共享任务等心理健康症状检索(Parapar等人,2024年). 高阶第一人称代词的使用与抑郁症的严重程度有可靠的关联(Rude等人,2004年;Tackman等人,2019年);低阶分析思维与心理痛苦(Corbin等人,2023年);饮食失调社区表现出可识别的词汇特征(Major等人,2016年)。 预受训练的情感分类器(Demszky等人,2020年;Hartmann,2022年)产生与固定词典互补的后级情感分布;它们是否在症状-网络分析中添加超出LIWC的信号直到现在还没有测试.

blocks.en: Pérez et al. (2023) score symptoms via semantic similarity to BDI-II phrasings on the same eRisk corpora, focusing on questionnaire-total prediction and sentence labeling, but not per-symptom network estimation and cross-disorder replication.
blocks.zh: Pérez等人(2023年)在同一eRisk corpora上通过语义上与BDI-II的语义相似来评分症状,侧重于问卷-总预测和句子标签,但不包括每个症状网络估计和交叉紊乱复制.

blocks.en: 3 Data and Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 数据和方法

blocks.en: Our framework has four components: We first extract linguistic and emotion features from each user’s posts (1), score each user on each questionnaire item by retrieving the posts closest in meaning to the item wording, which yields a continuous symptom expression score (2). We validate these scores against users’ questionnaire responses and test whether the linguistic patterns hold across disorders and datasets. We then use the scores in two analyses. The bridge analysis (3) correlates each symptom score with each linguistic feature. The network analysis (4) builds one symptom network from questionnaire responses and one from symptom expression scores, and compares their structure, including their communities.
blocks.zh: 我们的框架有四个组成部分: 我们首先从每个用户的帖子中抽取语言和情感特征(1), 我们对照用户的问卷答复来验证这些分数,并测试语言模式是否跨越失调和数据集。 然后我们用分数来分析 桥梁分析(3)将每个症状与每个语言特征联系起来。 网络分析(4)通过问卷答复建立一个症状网络,通过症状表达分数建立一个症状网络,并比较其结构,包括其社区。

blocks.en: 3.1 Datasets
blocks.zh: 3.1 数据集

blocks.en: We use three eRisk corpora. In the Depression corpus (eRisk 2021, N = 169 N=169 ), users completed the Beck Depression Inventory-II (BDI-II; Beck et al. 1996 ), whose 21 items each cover one depressive symptom, scored 0-3. In the Eating disorders corpus (eRisk 2022-2025, N = 92 N=92 ), users completed the Eating Disorder Examination Questionnaire (EDE-Q; Fairburn and Beglin 1994 ); we use its 22 items scored 0-6, which form four subscales (Restraint, Eating Concern, Shape Concern, Weight Concern). The Anorexia corpus (eRisk 2024, N = 784 N=784 ) has only binary labels based on self-stated diagnosis. In the two questionnaire corpora, per-item responses are the ground truth for validating symptom expression scores and for estimating clinical networks. All items and the short labels used in the paper are listed in Appendix A (Tables 11 and 12 ). Item meanings are fixed by the instruments: e.g., Crying is a depressive symptom, and its queries target that sense rather than a positive one.
blocks.zh: 我们使用三个ERISK公司。 在抑郁症(eRisk 2021,N = 169 N = 169)中,用户完成了贝克抑郁症编目-II(BDI-II;Beck et al. 1996),其21项各覆盖一个抑郁症,得分0-3. 在饮食紊乱症(eRisk 2022-2025,N = 92 N = 92)中,用户完成了饮食紊乱症检查问卷(EDE-Q;Fairburn和Beglin 1994 ;我们使用它的22项得分0-6,这四个分级(restricint, Eating concern,Shape Concern,Weight concern). 厌食症(eRisk 2024,N = 784 N = 784)只有基于自述诊断的二进制标签. 在两份问卷中,逐项答复是验证症状表达分数和估计临床网络的基本真理。 文件中使用的所有物品和短标签列于附录A(表11和12)。 物品意义由器件固定:例如,哭泣是一种抑郁症状,其查询目标为感知而非正觉.

blocks.en: The eRisk 2025 Task 1 release ( Parapar et al., 2026 ) , 28,025 annotated sentences pooled from earlier editions, is used separately to evaluate retrieval; given the similar data and task, we reproduce its top-performing systems. We do not compare against the official 2025 runs: our system was not in the judgment pool, so relevant sentences it retrieved but that were never judged would count as non-relevant, biasing the comparison against it.
blocks.zh: eRisk 2025任务1发布(Parapar et al., 2026),28,025个注释句集从之前的版本中被单独使用,用于评价检索;鉴于类似的数据和任务,我们复制其顶级功能系统. 我们没有与2025年正式运行相比:我们的系统不在判断库中,因此,它收回了相关的句子,但从未被判定为无关的句子,会偏见与它进行比较。

blocks.en: 3.2 Symptom Expression Validation
blocks.zh: 3.2 症状表达式验证

blocks.en: 3.2.1 Symptom Retrieval Pipeline
blocks.zh: 3.2.1 症状检索管道

blocks.en: We score each user against each questionnaire item using their own posts. Posts and items are embedded in a shared semantic space, and the cosine similarities are aggregated into an N users × N items N_{\text{users}}\times N_{\text{items}} matrix of symptom expression scores , which mirrors a completed questionnaire. The scores occupy a narrow range (EDE-Q subscale medians 0.41-0.46), as is typical of dense retrieval over a domain-homogeneous corpus; since all downstream analyses use Spearman correlations, only the ordering of users matters.
blocks.zh: 我们使用自己的帖子,对每个用户的问卷项目进行评分。 文章和项目嵌入一个共享的语义空间,同位素相似之处被汇总成一个N用户 × N项目 N_{\text{用户 {times N_{\text{items} 症状表达分数矩阵,它反映了一个已完成的问卷. 分数占据了狭义范围(EDE-Q亚尺度中位数为0.41-0.46),典型的是在域-同位素上密集检索;因为所有下游分析都使用Spearman相关,所以只有用户的订单才是重要的.

blocks.en: Posts are first filtered to those with LIWC first-person singular density i ≥ 1.0 \texttt{i}\geq 1.0 ( Pennebaker et al., 2003 ; Tausczik and Pennebaker, 2010 ) , so that scores reflect the user’s own experience; an ablation explores this filter.
blocks.zh: 文章首先过滤到LIWC第一人称单数密度 i\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\ 1.0(Pennebaker等人,2003年;Tausczik和Pennebaker,2010年),这样得分就反映了用户自身的经验;ablation探索这个过滤器.

blocks.en: Retrieval follows the two-stage bi-encoder cascade of the top-performing eRisk 2025 systems. Stage 1 ranks filtered posts with all-MiniLM-L6-v2 1 1 1 https://huggingface.co/sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 and keeps the top 1,000 per symptom; Stage 2 re-encodes them with bge-large 2 2 2 https://huggingface.co/BAAI/bge-large-en-v1.5 , and the user score is their mean Stage-2 similarity. Since no user has more than 1,000 filtered posts (maximum 878), Stage 1 keeps all of them, and the score averages over a user’s full self-referential history; Stage 1 selection matters for sentence retrieval on eRisk. BDI-II queries average the embeddings of severity phrasings 1-3 (severity 0 excluded) and are L2-renormalized; EDE-Q items have a single phrasing each.
blocks.zh: 检索遵循最高性能的eRisk 2025系统的两级双编码器级联. 1 1 1 1 1 1 https://huggingface.co/pentence-transfers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 对过滤员额进行排名 并保持每个症状前1000名; 第2阶段用bge-great 2 2 2 https://huggingface.co/BAAI/bge-great-en-v1.5重新编码,用户得分是他们的平均值第2阶段的相似性. 由于没有用户超过1000个过滤帖(最多为878个),第1阶段保留了所有这些帖子,且在用户完整的自我优惠历史中得分平均值; 第1阶段选择eRisk上的句子检索事项. BDI-II查询平均重度修饰1-3的嵌入词(不包含绝对0),并且是L2-再正常化;EDE-Q项目各有一个单词.

blocks.en: Sentence-level relevance data exist only for depression, so we select the configuration there and apply it to EDE-Q unchanged; tuning it on ED would mean optimizing against the same responses used for validation. As the encoders are general-purpose and only the queries change, we treat the ED analysis as a test of transfer across instruments. Transfer is partial: depression subsampled to N = 92 N{=}92 (2,000 draws) keeps a median composite ρ \rho of 0.43 and 16/21 FDR-significant items and never falls to the ED level, so sample size alone might not explain the weaker ED results, which we report as exploratory.
blocks.zh: 句级相关数据仅存在抑郁症,因此我们选择了那里的配置,并将其应用到EDE-Q上,不变;在ED上调整它,将意味着根据用于验证的相同响应进行优化. 由于编码器是通用的,只有查询会改变,我们把ED分析作为跨仪器传输的测试. 转移是局部的:低气压被取样为 N = 92 N = 92 (2 000图纸) 的中位复合物 ^\rho 0.43 和 16/21 FDR 的显著项目,从未降为ED级,因此,仅样本大小可能无法解释较弱的ED结果,我们报告为探索性结果。

blocks.en: As classical baselines, we score users with BM25 and TF-IDF (corpus-level term weights), keeping the post pool, filter, and aggregation fixed so that only the scoring method differs. To test sensitivity, we recompute the depression scores under alternative query recipes, aggregations (median, maximum, top- k k mean), candidate pools ( k = 10 k{=}10 - 250 250 ), and encoders (MiniLM only), and re-estimate the network for each.
blocks.zh: 作为经典的基线,我们用BM25和TF-IDF(公司级术语权重)来评分用户,保持邮池,过滤器,和汇总的固定,以便只有评分方法不同. 为了测试灵敏度,我们重新计算抑郁症的分数,在替代查询食谱,聚合(中间,最大,最高-k k 平均值),候选池(k = 10 k{=}10 - 250 250 ),以及编码器(只有MiniLM)下,并重新估计每个域的网络.

blocks.en: 3.2.2 Linguistic Feature Extraction
blocks.zh: 3.2.2 语言特征提取

blocks.en: Linguistic features capture how distress manifests in word choice, emotional tone, and topic distribution without the user naming a symptom directly. We use three feature families that have established psychometric and clinical histories: lexicon-based features using LIWC-22 ( Boyd et al., 2022 ) for functional, affective, cognitive, social, and content-domain dimensions; corpus-based emotion features using the Hartmann 7-emotion DistilRoBERTa classifier ( Hartmann, 2022 ) and GoEmotions 28-emotion classifier ( Demszky et al., 2020 ) for emotion-probability distributions; and within-user variability indices (standard deviations of emotion probabilities across the user’s posts). Post-level features are averaged to user level. The full feature vector contains 191 dimensions.
blocks.zh: 语言特征捕捉苦恼如何表现在字词选择,情感语气,和话题分布中,而用户不直接命名症状. 我们使用三个建立了心理计量和临床历史的特征家族:使用LIWC-22(Boyd等人,2022年)的基于词典的特征,用于功能、情感、认知、社会和内容域维度;使用Hartmann 7-情绪Distil RoBERTA分类器(Hartmann,2022年)和GoEmotions 28-情绪分类器(Demszky等人,2020年)的基于词典的特征,用于情绪概率分布;以及用户内部的可变性指数(用户职位的情绪概率的标准偏差)。 后级功能平均为用户级. 全功能矢量包含191维.

blocks.en: 3.2.3 Dimensional Validation
blocks.zh: 3.2.3 维度验证

blocks.en: The validation question is whether NLP-derived symptom expression scores actually correspond to clinical responses on the same items. In this sense, for each user we compute a per-symptom symptom expression score and a composite symptom expression score as the mean across symptoms. The validation targets are the user’s actual questionnaire responses on the corresponding items, and the questionnaire total for the composite. Validation correlations use Spearman ρ \rho and per-symptom correlations are FDR-corrected via Benjamini-Hochberg ( Benjamini and Hochberg, 1995 ) within the item family for each instrument. Bootstrap 95% confidence intervals on each ρ \rho use 1000 resamples. We interpret | ρ | < 0.20 |\rho|<0.20 as negligible, 0.20 0.20 - 0.30 0.30 as weak, 0.30 0.30 - 0.50 0.50 as adequate, and ≥ 0.50 \geq 0.50 as strong, following Gignac and Szodorai (2016) ; Cohen’s benchmarks ( Cohen, 1988 ) are not used here because they were not derived from an empirical distribution of psychological correlations.
blocks.zh: 验证问题在于NLP派生的症状表达分数是否与相同物品上的临床反应实际对应. 从这个意义上讲,对于每个用户来说,我们计算出每个症状的表达分数和综合症状表达分数,作为跨症状的平均值。 验证目标是用户对相应项目的实际问卷答复,以及综合问卷总数。 校验相关性使用Spearman à\rho, 并且每个乐器的每个乐器都通过Benjamini-Hochberg(Benjamini和Hochberg, 1995年)在项目家族中修正FDR。 每个 $\rho 上95%的置信间隔 使用 1000 个重印 。 依据Gignac和Szodorai(2016年), 科恩的基准(Cohen, 1988年)在这里没有被使用, 因为这些基准并非来自心理关联的经验分布。

blocks.en: At N = 92 N{=}92 with 22 items, per-item ED analyses have limited power, and the power-matched comparison (Section 3.2.1 ) shows that the weaker ED results are not explained by sample size alone. ED per-item results are therefore reported as exploratory.
blocks.zh: 在N = 92 N + 92 和 22 项时,每件ED分析的功率有限,而电比比较(第3.2.1节)显示,弱的ED结果不能仅用样本大小来解释. 因此,ED逐项结果被报告为探索性结果。

blocks.en: 3.2.4 Split-half Reliability
blocks.zh: 3.2.4 半拆分可靠性

blocks.en: To assess the internal consistency of scores independent of their convergence with self-report, each user’s filtered posts are randomly split into two halves of equal size (within-user). Per-symptom symptom expression scores are recomputed on each half using the same retrieval pipeline. Between-half correlations across users (Spearman ρ \rho ) are then Spearman-Brown corrected to estimate full-length reliability, with literature supporting thresholds of above 0.7 as acceptable for exploratory research, above 0.8 as good, and above 0.9 as most preferable ( Nunnally and Bernstein, 1994 ) .
blocks.zh: 为了评估内部的一致程度,而不论其与自我报告的趋同程度,每个用户被过滤的帖子都随机分成大小相等的两半(用户内部)。 偶发症状表达分数每半个使用相同的检索管道重算. 用户之间的半相关关系(Spearman à \rho)随后被纠正,以估计全长可靠性,文献支持的阈值为0.7以上,为探索性研究所接受,0.8以上为良好,0.9以上为最佳(Nunnally和Bernstein,1994年)。

blocks.zh: 3.2.5 自分配过滤器

blocks.en: 3.2.6 eRisk 2025 Retrieval Evaluation
blocks.zh: 3.2.6eRisk 2025检索评价

blocks.en: We also evaluate against the eRisk 2025 Task 1 benchmark ( Parapar et al., 2026 ) , which uses pooled human relevance judgments at the sentence level. The release provides a test corpus of ≈ 17.5 {\approx}17.5 M sentences from 9,000 users with majority-vote (2/3 assessors) relevance judgments, comprising ≈ {\approx} 21K judged sentence-symptom pairs across the 21 BDI-II items; we also tested a cross-encoder with fine-tuning using the corresponding training qrels.

The primary metric we opt for is bpref (binary preference) ( Buckley and Voorhees, 2004 ) , an evaluation metric for the relative ranks of relevant and irrelevant documents which is robust to incomplete relevance judgments arising from shallow pooling. Auxiliary metrics (MAP, nDCG@10/100/1000, P@10, MRR) are reported but biased downward under the same condition. Multiple configurations are compared: BGE bi-encoder only; BGE + off-the-shelf cross-encoder; two-stage cascade (primary); MiniLM bi-only baseline; BGE + fine-tuned cross-encoder.
blocks.zh: 我们选择的主要衡量标准是bpref(二进制偏好)(Buckley和Voorhees,2004年),这是对相关和无关文件相对等级的评价衡量标准,对浅层集合所产生的不完整的相关判断十分有力。 辅助度量衡(MAP, nDCG@10/100,P@10,MRR)在相同条件下报告但偏下. 比较多个配置:仅BGE双编码器;BGE + 现成的交叉编码器;两级级联(主级);微型LM BGE + 微调的交叉编码器。

blocks.en: 3.3 Cross-disorder and Cross-dataset Analyses
blocks.zh: 3.3 交叉失调和交叉数据集分析

blocks.en: The cross-disorder analysis asks whether the same linguistic features separate symptomatic from control users across the three corpora, which differ in disorder and recruitment. For each corpus, we compare positive and control users on 134 linguistic features with Mann-Whitney U U tests, reporting rank-biserial r r with BH-FDR correction across features. Each feature is categorized by its pattern of significance and direction: transdiagnostic (significant in all three corpora, same direction), shared (significant in exactly two, same direction), disorder-specific (significant in one, reported per disorder), mixed-direction (significant in two or more, with opposite signs), and non-discriminating (significant in none). To test whether the transdiagnostic features form construct families, we represent each by its three effect sizes, standardized per corpus, and group them with Ward hierarchical clustering, choosing the number of families by silhouette score over k ∈ { 3 , 4 , 5 } k\in\{3,4,5\} .
blocks.zh: 交叉紊乱分析询问,同一语言特征是否将症状与三股股股的控制用户区分开来,这在紊乱和招募方面有所不同. 对于每个生物体,我们比较134个语言特征的阳性和控制用户与Mann-Whitney U U测试,报告等级-biserial r和BH-FDR校正跨特征. 每个特征按其意义和方向的规律分类:转诊(在所有三个科氏体中都具有重大意义,方向相同),共有(完全两个,方向相同),特定障碍(一个显著,每个障碍都报告),混合方向(两个或两个以上显著,有相反的征兆),以及无区别(没有显著)。 为了检验转诊特征是否形成家庭,我们按其三个效果大小分别代表每个家庭,标准化的每个家庭,并将其与沃德分级分组,通过 silhouette 得分比 k { { 3, 4, 5 } k\in 3,4, 5 } 选择家庭数量。

blocks.en: The cross-dataset analysis applies the EDE-Q pipeline unchanged to the anorexia corpus and compares symptom expression scores between anorexia-positive and control users, and between anorexia-positive and ED-positive users. As the anorexia corpus has no EDE-Q responses, this tests whether the scores generalize to an independently recruited sample, not their dimensional validity.
blocks.zh: 跨数据集分析将EDE-Q输油管不加修改地应用于厌食体,并比较厌食与控制用户之间以及厌食与ED阳性用户之间的症状表达分数. 由于厌食症没有EDE-Q的响应,这检验了分数是否概括到独立招募的样本,而不是其维度有效性.

blocks.en: 3.4 Network Analysis
blocks.zh: 3.4 网络分析

blocks.en: The retrieval pipeline produces a per-user, per-symptom score matrix that mirrors a completed questionnaire’s structure. From that matrix we estimate a symptom network and compare it to the network estimated from the corresponding clinical questionnaire responses. The networks are compared at four structural levels: edge weights, centrality, community membership, and bridge symptoms.
blocks.zh: 检索管道生成一个每个用户、每个症状的分数矩阵,反映填写完毕的问题单的结构。 从这个矩阵中,我们估计了一个症状网络,并将其与相应的临床调查问卷答复中估计的网络进行比较。 网络在四个结构层面进行比较:边重、中心、社区成员以及桥梁症状。

blocks.en: 3.4.1 Network estimation
blocks.zh: 3.4.1 网络估计

blocks.en: Networks are estimated as Gaussian Graphical Models via EBICglasso ( Friedman et al., 2008 ) with γ \gamma (which controls model complexity and sparsity) = 0.5 =0.5 ( Foygel and Drton, 2010 ) . All networks use Spearman correlations as input: this accommodates the ordinal nature of questionnaire responses, is robust to outliers in NLP cosine scores, and gives a uniform estimation procedure across clinical and linguistic networks, which is a prerequisite for the Network Comparison Test ( van Borkulo et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 网络通过EBICglasso(Friedman等人,2008年)估算为高斯图形模型,其中\gamma(控制模型复杂度和螺旋性)=0.5=0.5(Foygel和Drton,2010年). 所有网络都使用斯皮尔曼相关性作为输入:这满足了调查问卷回复的正则性质,在NLP的余弦分数中强到异常值,并给出了整个临床和语言网络的统一估计程序,这是网络比较测试的先决条件(van Borkulo等人,2023年).

blocks.en: 3.4.2 Network metrics
blocks.zh: 3.4.2 网络计量

blocks.en: We use Expected Influence ( Robinaugh et al., 2016 ) as it handles negative partial correlations correctly. For bridge centrality we employed one-step Bridge Expected Influence ( Jones et al., 2021 ) , computed with each network’s own Walktrap partition. Bridge centrality depends on community membership; we quantify cross-modality bridge agreement by Spearman rank correlation of the Bridge EI vectors between the clinical and NLP symptom expression networks, a standard centrality-stability measure ( Epskamp et al., 2018 ) .
blocks.zh: 我们使用预期影响(Robinaugh等人,2016年),因为它正确处理负面的部分关联。 使用单步桥预期影响(Jones等人,2021年), 桥梁中心化取决于社区成员;我们量化了Spearman在临床和NLP症状表达网络之间的桥梁EI矢量的关联性跨模式桥梁协议,这是标准的核心稳定度量(Epskamp等人,2018年).

blocks.en: 3.4.3 Community Detection
blocks.zh: 3.4.3 社区检测

blocks.en: Walktrap algorithm ( Pons and Latapy, 2006 ) at t = 4 t=4 is applied directly to the EBICglasso adjacency matrix. Partition agreement between clinical and NLP communities is measured by Adjusted Rand Index ( Hubert and Arabie, 1985 ) , which looks at the similarity between two data clusterings while correcting for random chance. While classic cluster recovery simulation benchmarks strictly demand an ARI > 0.65 ( Steinley, 2004 ) , such thresholds assume identical underlying data structures. Following the chance-corrected classification framework of Landis and Koch (1977) , we defined an ARI > 0.25 as fair cross-modality structural alignment and an ARI > 0.50 as moderate-to-strong alignment.
blocks.zh: 步行陷阱算法 (Pons和Latapy,2006年) t = 4 t = 4 直接应用于EBICglasso辅助基质. 临床社区与NLP社区之间的分区协议通过调整的Rand指数(Hubert and Arabie, 1985)来衡量,该指数研究了两个数据集群之间的相似性,同时纠正随机机会. 虽然典型的集群恢复模拟基准严格要求一个ARI > 0.65(Steinley,2004年),这种阈值假定了相同的基础数据结构。 根据Landis和Koch(1977年)的概率校正分类框架,我们将一个 > 0.25的ARI定义为公平的跨模式结构调整和ARI > 0.50作为中坚对接.

blocks.en: 3.4.4 Network Comparison Test and Stability
blocks.zh: 3.4.4 网络比较试验和稳定性

blocks.en: The NCT ( van Borkulo et al., 2023 ) provides permutation-based hypothesis tests for differences between two estimated networks. With 1000 permutations we compute the M-test (maximum edge difference), global strength test, per-edge difference tests with BH-FDR correction across edges, and per-node centrality difference tests with BH-FDR correction across nodes.
blocks.zh: NCT(van Borkulo等人,2023年)为两个估计网络之间的差异提供了基于穿透的假说测试. 我们通过1000个长程计数计算M测试(最大边差),全球强度测试,通过BH-FDR校正横跨边缘的近缘差测试,以及用BH-FDR校正横跨节点的每个节点中心差测试.

blocks.en: CS-coefficients are estimated via case-dropping bootstrap. The CS-coefficient is the maximum case-drop proportion that preserves correlation >= 0.7 with full-sample centrality in 95% of resamples. netSimulator ( Epskamp and Fried, 2018 ) provides power analysis at observed N by simulating data under a known network and estimating recovered sensitivity, specificity, and edge-weight correlation.
blocks.zh: CS-协同效应通过案例投放靴子来估算. CS-Coeculity是95%的复标中保留关联性QQ 0.7与全样本中心化的最大案例投放比例. netSimulator(Epskamp and Fried,2018)通过模拟已知网络下的数据并估计恢复后的灵敏度,特异性,以及边重关系,提供观测N的功率分析.

blocks.en: 3.4.5 Symptom-feature bridge matrices
blocks.zh: 3.4.5 症状特异性桥梁矩阵

blocks.en: For each symptom and linguistic feature, we compute Spearman ρ \rho between user-level symptom expression scores and user-level feature averages, with BH-FDR correction over all symptom-feature pairs in a matrix. We compute three matrices: BDI items × \times features ( N = 169 N{=}169 ; 21 × 191 = 4011 21\times 191{=}4011 tests), EDE-Q items × \times features in the ED corpus ( N = 92 N{=}92 ; 4202 tests), and the same EDE-Q items × \times features in the anorexia corpus ( N = 782 N{=}782 ; 4180 tests).
blocks.zh: 对于每个症状和语言特征,我们计算Spearman à\rho在用户级症状表达分数和用户级特征平均值之间,在矩阵中对所有症状特征对BH-FDR进行校正. 我们计算三个矩阵:BDI项×时间特征(N = 169 N{=}169;21 × 191 = 4011 21时间 191 {=}4011测试),EDE-Q项×时间特征(N = 92 N{=}92;4202测试),以及同EDE-Q项×时间特征(N = 782 N{=}782;4180测试).

blocks.en: Since the ED matrix is underpowered, we identify associations that hold across both eating-disorder corpora: pairs that are FDR-significant in the anorexia corpus and reach | ρ | ≥ 0.20 |\rho|\geq 0.20 in the same direction in the ED corpus. Replication in two independently recruited samples makes these pairs less likely to reflect corpus-specific artefacts. The 0.20 floor was pre-specified as the smallest effect size of interest ( Lakens et al., 2018 ) ; at N = 92 N{=}92 it gives about 48% power, above r = 0.16 r{=}0.16 , the effect detectable with 33% power at this sample size ( Simonsohn, 2015 ) . Results at floors of 0.15 and 0.25 are reported in Appendix A , Table 8 .
blocks.zh: 由于ED矩阵的能量不足,我们发现一些关联,它们跨越了饮食紊乱体:在厌食体中具有FDR重要性的对子,在ED体中也朝着同一方向达到 ^ ^ ^ 0.20 → rho|\geq 0.20。 复制两个独立采集的样本,使得这些对子更不可能反映具体生物体的工艺品。 0.20层被预先指定为利息最小效应大小(Lakens等人,2018年);在N = 92 N = 92中,它给出了大约48%的功率,高于r = 0.16 r = 0.16,在这个样本大小上以33%的功率可探测效应(Simonsohn,2015年). 附录A表8报告了0.15和0.25的下限结果。

blocks.en: LIWC i serves both as the post-level filter and as a feature in the bridge matrices. The two are related but distinct: the filter is a binary gate on individual posts, while the feature is a continuous average over all of a user’s posts.
blocks.zh: LIWCi既作为后级过滤器,也作为桥梁矩阵中的一个特征. 两者是相关但又截然不同的:过滤器是单个帖子上的二进制闸门,而功能是所有用户帖子的连续平均值.

blocks.en: 4 Results
blocks.zh: 4 结果

blocks.en: 4.1 Symptom Expression Retrieval
blocks.zh: 4.1 症状表达式检索

blocks.en: 4.1.1 eRisk 2025 Task 1 Annotated Data Performance
blocks.zh: 4.1.1 2025年电子风险 数据性能

blocks.en: Performance metrics computed on the eRisk 2025 Task 1 annotated data show that the cascade approach achieves the highest bpref (0.6746). Fine-tuning the cross-encoder on eRisk training qrels does not improve over off-the-shelf weights ( Δ ​ bpref \Delta\text{bpref} =0.0017). The cascade no-filter approach matches the primary on every metric, confirming that the i -filter affects only user-level aggregation, not sentence ranking. Full results are visible in Appendix A , Table 4 .
blocks.zh: 根据eRisk 2025任务1附加说明的数据表明,级联方法达到了最高的bref(0.6746)。 精细调整eRisk训练qrels上的交叉编码器不会比现成的重量提高(QQ bpref\Delta\text{bpref}=0.0017). 级联无过滤器方法与每个公尺上的初级相匹配,确认i - filter只影响用户级聚合,而不是句子排名. 全部结果可见于附录A表4。

blocks.en: 4.1.2 Dimensional Validation
blocks.zh: 4.1.2 维度验证

blocks.en: The primary configuration outperforms the alternative configurations and the sparse baselines (Appendix A , Table 10 ): 20 of 21 BDI items reach FDR significance, and the composite correlation is ρ = 0.434 \rho{=}0.434 ( p < 10 − 8 p{<}10^{-8} ). Q17 (Irritability) does not survive FDR correction, and Q3 (Past Failure) and Q6 (Punishment) are the weakest significant items.
blocks.zh: 主配置优于替代配置和稀疏基线(Appendix A,表10):21个BDI项目中有20个达到FDR意义,复合关联性为^ 0.434\rho{=}0.434(p < 10 - 8 p{<}10^{-8}). Q17(易怒性)在FDR校正后无法幸存,Q3(过去失败)和Q6(惩罚)是最弱的重要项目.

blocks.en: ED results are weaker. The composite correlation is ρ = 0.200 \rho{=}0.200 ( p = 0.057 p{=}0.057 ), and no item reaches FDR significance. Since depression subsampled to N = 92 N{=}92 never falls to this level (Section 3.2.1 ), the gap is not only a matter of sample size; it may reflect weaker transfer of the configuration, less explicit textual expression of EDE-Q symptoms, or differences between the instruments. Subscale correlations range from 0.15 to 0.20, with Shape Concern ( ρ = 0.202 \rho{=}0.202 , p = 0.055 p{=}0.055 ) and Eating Concern ( ρ = 0.200 \rho{=}0.200 , p = 0.057 p{=}0.057 ) closest to significance.
blocks.zh: ED结果较弱. 复合相关值为 $ = 0.200\rho = 0.200 (p = 0.057 p = 0.057),没有项目达到 FDR 意义. 由于抑郁症被子抽样到N=92 N{=}92从未降为这个级别(第3.2.1节),因此这一差距不仅仅是一个样本大小的问题;它可能反映配置的转移较弱,EDE-Q症状的文字表达不太明确,或者仪器之间的差异. 亚尺度关联度介于0.15至0.20之间,与意义最接近的有形状关注度(^ 0.202\rho 0.202,p = 0.055 p 0.055)和饮食关注度(^ 0.200\rho 0.200,p = 0.057 p 0.057).

blocks.en: 4.1.3 Split-half Reliability
blocks.zh: 4.1.3 半拆分可靠性

blocks.en: Within-user split-half reliability is measured through composite Spearman-Brown corrected, resulting in a value of 0.935. All 21 BDI symptoms exceed 0.90 (range 0.901-0.944), indicating that symptom expression scores are highly stable across random post halves. The moderate composite correlation with self-report ( ρ \rho =0.434) reflects more between-measure differences rather than unreliability in the NLP measurement.
blocks.zh: 通过复合Spearman-Brown校正测量用户内部的半衰期可靠性,得出0.935. 所有21个BDI症状都超过了0.90(范围为0.901-0.944),表明症状表达分数在随机后半部分高度稳定. 与自报的温和的复合关系(à\rho = 0.434)更反映了计量之间的差异,而不是NLP测量中的不可靠性.

blocks.en: 4.1.4 Sensitivity to Retrieval Choices
blocks.zh: 4.1.4 对检索选择的敏感性

blocks.en: Validity is stable across query recipes (severity 1, 3, or averaged: ρ = 0.43 \rho{=}0.43 - 0.45 0.45 , 19-20 items FDR-significant), between mean and median aggregation ( ρ = 0.43 \rho{=}0.43 vs. 0.41 0.41 ), and largely with a weaker encoder (MiniLM only: ρ = 0.36 \rho{=}0.36 , 16 items). It depends on averaging over the full post history, with scoring only the top 10-50 posts per symptom reducing ρ \rho to 0.19-0.22, and maximum aggregation to 0.16. The gain of the primary configuration over the BGE-only and cross-encoder configurations, which score users by their top 20 posts, therefore comes from this aggregation. Across variants, the re-estimated NLP networks correlate 0.68-0.97 with the primary network.
blocks.zh: 有效性在各种查询食谱之间是稳定的(绝对值1,3,或平均值: ^ 0.43\rho 0.43 - 04.5, 19-20项FDR - 显著值),介于平均和中位聚合值之间( ^ 0.43\rho 0.43对0.41 0.41), 基本上与较弱的编码符(MiniLM只: ^0.36\rho 0.36, 16项)。 这取决于整个邮政历史的平均值,每个症状的得分只有最高的10-50个,将\rho降至0.19-0.22,最大汇总为0.16。 因此,主配置优于BGE和交叉编码器配置,这些配置以用户前20名获得分数,来自这一汇总. 在各种变体中,重新估计的NLP网络与主网络相关联0.68-0.97。

blocks.en: 4.1.5 Self-attribution Filter Ablation
blocks.zh: 4.1.5 自分配过滤器

blocks.en: The LIWC filter and no-filter conditions are empirically equivalent ( Δ ​ ρ \Delta\rho = 0.009). The filter is therefore not needed for validity; we retain it for theoretical grounding, since the score should reflect the user’s own state rather than their commentary on others.
blocks.zh: LIWC过滤器和无过滤器条件在经验上是等效的(\\\Delta\rho = 0.009). 因此,有效性不需要过滤器;我们保留过滤器是为了理论基础,因为分数应反映用户自己的状态,而不是他们对他人的评论。

blocks.en: 4.2 Cross-disorder and Cross-dataset Analyses
blocks.zh: 4.2 交叉失调和交叉数据集分析

blocks.en: Applied to the anorexia corpus, the EDE-Q pipeline yields 782 × 22 782\times 22 symptom scores (2 of 784 users lack sufficient posts after filtering). All 22 items separate anorexia-positive from control users (rank-biserial | r | = 0.91 |r|{=}0.91 - 0.94 0.94 , all FDR-significant), consistent with the pipeline retrieving topically appropriate content. ED users score higher than anorexia users on all four subscales (e.g., Restraint medians 0.441 vs. 0.414; r ≈ 0.44 r{\approx}0.44 - 0.47 0.47 , all q < 0.001 q{<}0.001 ), consistent with questionnaire-screened ED users writing more EDE-Q-relevant content than anorexia users, whose histories cover a wider range of topics.
blocks.zh: EDE-Q输油管应用于厌食症, 所有22项都将厌食阳性与控制用户区分开来(排名-biserial | r = = 0.91 r|{=} 0.91 - 0.94 0.94,均为FDR 0.94),符合管道检索适合的主题内容. ED用户在所有四个亚尺度(如限制中位数0.441对0.414;r 0.44 r 近似 0.44 - 0.47 0.47,均q < 0.001 q 0.001)上得分均高于厌食用户,这与问卷筛选的ED用户撰写的EDE-Q相关内容多于厌食用户,其历史涵盖了更广泛的话题.

blocks.en: Of the 134 features, 29 are transdiagnostic (Figure 1 ); the rest are shared by two disorders (69), disorder-specific (22: anorexia 12, depression 6, ED 4), non-discriminating (12), or mixed-direction (2) (Appendix A , Figure 3 ). The strongest is the first-person singular pronoun (LIWC i ; mean r = + 0.58 r{=}+0.58 ; anorexia + 0.79 +0.79 , depression + 0.50 +0.50 , ED + 0.45 +0.45 ), which extends the depression finding of Rude et al. (2004) to two further disorders and supports reading it as a marker of self-focused distress rather than of depression specifically. Since all 29 features keep their direction across three independently recruited samples, and the two emotion classifiers, trained on different data and label sets, agree in direction, the pattern is unlikely to be an artefact of a single study design, recruitment frame, or instrument.
blocks.zh: 在134个特征中,29个特征为转诊(图1);其余特征为2个障碍(69个),具体障碍(22个:厌食12个,抑郁6个,ED4个),无歧义(12个),或混合方向(2)(附录A,图3). 最强的是第一人称单数代词(LIWC i; 平均r = + 0.58 r{=}+0.58;厌食症 + 0.79 + 0.50 + 0.50 + ED + 04.5 + 0.45 ),将鲁德等人(2004年)的抑郁症发现扩展至另外两种障碍,并支持将其解读为自我聚焦的忧郁症而非抑郁症的标志. 由于所有29种特征都保持其方向贯穿于三个独立招聘的样本中,两个情感分类者经过不同数据和标签集的培训,在方向上达成一致,所以这种模式不太可能是单一研究设计、招聘框架或仪器的造型。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Signed rank-biserial effects of the 29 transdiagnostic features in each disorder. Positive values indicate features elevated in symptomatic users.
blocks.zh: 图 1:每个障碍中29个转诊特征的符号级比效应. 正值表明症状使用者的特征增加。

blocks.en: Ward clustering groups the transdiagnostic features into three families (silhouette = 0.55 =0.55 ; Appendix A , Table 5 ): (1) reduced externally oriented language (analytic style, clout, neutral tone, curiosity, and references to money, space, motion, and leisure; mean r = − 0.39 r{=}-0.39 ); (2) elevated self-focused affect (first-person pronouns with GoEmotions grief, sadness, nervousness, caring, and relief; mean r = + 0.53 r{=}+0.53 ); and (3) elevated somatic content (LIWC health, illness, and physical terms with Hartmann fear and sadness; mean r = + 0.44 r{=}+0.44 ). The set is therefore not reducible to a single negative-affect dimension, and it includes positive-valence emotions (relief, caring) that are elevated in symptomatic users.
blocks.zh: 沃德将转诊特征分组为三个家庭(轮廓=0.55=0.55;附录A,表5): (1) 减少外向语言(分析风格、影响力、中性语调、好奇心和提及金钱、空间、运动和休闲;平均r = 0.39 r = 0.39-0.39);(2) 提高自我重点影响(第一人称代词:GoEmotions悲伤、悲伤、紧张、关爱和救济;平均r = + 0.53 r = 0.53);以及(3) 提高体质内容(LIWC健康、疾病和物理术语:Hartmann恐惧和悲伤;平均r = + 0.44 r = 0.4)。 因此,该集不能被降格为单一的负效应维度,它包括了在症状使用者中被提升的正值情感(缓解,关怀).

The NLP subscale network places all four EDE-Q subscales in a single community, suggesting that ED-related language does not separate Restraint, Eating, Shape, and Weight Concern as the instrument’s subscales propose. Against the two-factor BDI-II solution of Beck et al. blocks.en: Bridge centrality diverges more than Expected Influence (Appendix A , Table 6 ). The BDI clinical and NLP top-5 bridges do not overlap, and for EDE-Q only Empty Stomach is shared. Across the full rankings, Bridge EI vectors correlate at ρ = − 0.15 \rho{=}-0.15 for BDI and ρ = + 0.10 \rho{=}+0.10 for EDE-Q. blocks.en: The BDI NLP bridges are mostly self-directed cognitions (Guilt, Worthlessness) and high-arousal states (Agitation, Irritability), whereas the clinical bridges include cognitive-motivational (Concentration, Loss of Interest) and somatic (Loss of Energy) symptoms, which may be endorsed on questionnaires more than they are written about. Both modalities identify an anhedonia bridge but differ in its form: Loss of Interest clinically, Loss of Pleasure linguistically. The self-referential emphasis of the NLP bridges is consistent with Rude et al. (2004) and Tackman et al. (2019) .
blocks.zh: BDI NLP桥大多是自我引导的认知(Guilt,Worthless)和高刺激状态(Agitation,Iritability),而临床桥梁包括认知动力(Concentation,Los of Energy)和somatic(Loss of Energy)症状,这些症状在问卷上可能比写得更多. 两种模式都确定了一条安希多尼亚桥,但其形式不同: 在临床上失去兴趣 在语言上失去快乐 NLP桥的自我优惠强调与Rude等人(2004年)和Tackman等人(2019年)一致.

blocks.en: 4.4 Network Comparison Test
blocks.zh: 4.4 网络比较 测试

blocks.en: For BDI, 6 of 210 edges (2.9%) differ FDR-significantly between modalities; for EDE-Q items, 12 of 231 (5.2%); for EDE-Q subscales, none. This agreement is expected, since both networks are estimated over the same items and inherit their shared content, and it indicates that the text-derived network preserves the instrument’s structure, consistent with both networks recovering the BDI-II factor solution (Section 4.3 ). Edge agreement is therefore necessary but not sufficient, and it holds across all retrieval variants in the sensitivity analysis (Appendix A , Table 9 ). The more informative comparisons are at the level of bridges, where the modalities diverge, and of individual nodes.
blocks.zh: 就BDI而言,210个边值中的6个(2.9%)在模式之间有显著的FDR差异;就EDE-Q项目而言,231个边值中的12个边值(2.2%);就EDE-Q子尺度而言,没有。 这一协议是预期的,因为两个网络都是在同一个项目上估计并继承其共享内容的,它表明,文本衍生的网络保持了文书的结构,与两个恢复BDI-II因数解决方案的网络一致(第4.3节)。 因此,边缘协议是必要的,但还不够,它在敏感性分析(附录A,表9)中涵盖所有检索变量。 比较资料较多的是不同方式的桥梁一级和个别节点一级。

blocks.en: Two nodes differ in centrality: Guilt is more central clinically ( Δ ​ EI = − 0.544 \Delta\text{EI}{=}-0.544 , q = 0.021 q{=}0.021 ), and Shape Self Worth more central linguistically ( Δ ​ EI = + 0.395 \Delta\text{EI}{=}+0.395 , q = 0.044 q{=}0.044 ). This suggests that guilt is endorsed on the questionnaire more than it is written about, while shape-based self-evaluation is written about beyond its questionnaire weight, a difference between what people put into words and what they report on a scale.

blocks.en: To test whether the scores carry symptom-specific information beyond overall severity, we ran a multitrait-multimethod analysis after removing each user’s mean score from both the text and questionnaire profiles (ipsatizing), so that only relative symptom elevation remains. Same-symptom correlations between text and questionnaire stay positive (mean r = 0.08 r{=}0.08 ), while different-symptom correlations fall to zero (mean r = 0.00 r{=}0.00 ). A supervised baseline we also tested shows no such separation. The effect, while modest, indicates that the retrieval scores capture which symptoms are elevated within a user, not only how severe they are.
blocks.zh: 为了检验这些分数是否包含超过整体严重程度的症状信息,我们在从文本和问卷简介中移除每个用户的平均分数后进行了多轨-多轨分析(Patatization),因此仅留下相对症状升高。 文本和问卷的同义关系保持正数(平均r = 0.08 r = 0.08),而异义关系则降至0(平均r = 0.00 r = 0. 我们还测试的有监督的基线显示没有这种分离。 效果虽然不大,但表明检索分数捕捉到用户体内哪些症状升高,而不仅是其严重程度.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusions and Future Work
blocks.zh: 5. 结论和今后的工作

blocks.en: Symptom networks don’t need to be built from questionnaires alone. To our knowledge, this is the first work to estimate symptom-resolved psychometric networks from social media text, compare them with questionnaire-based networks using the Network Comparison Test, and identify linguistic markers that replicate across three independently recruited corpora spanning two disorders. For depression, scores derived only from users’ posts, using an adapted eRisk retrieval pipeline, correlate significantly with 20 of 21 BDI-II items (composite ρ = 0.434 \rho{=}0.434 ), robustly across query recipes and encoders; for eating disorders, results are weaker and exploratory.
blocks.zh: 症状网络不需要单靠问卷构建。 据我们所知,这是从社交媒体文本中估算症状解开的心理测量网络的第一项工作,利用网络比较测试与基于问卷的网络进行比较,并找出在三个独立招募的横跨两种紊乱的蝎子身上复制的语言标记。 对于抑郁症,只有用户使用经过调整的eRisk检索管道的帖子才能得分,与21个BDI-II项目中的20个(composite ë = 0.434\rho ^ 0.434)有很大关联,在查询食谱和编码器之间很强;对于饮食紊乱,结果较弱且具有探索性。

blocks.en: The comparison yields one central finding: text and questionnaires agree on which symptoms go together, but not on which ones connect the network. Most edges are shared, yet the bridge symptoms differ almost entirely, with language emphasizing self-directed cognitions such as guilt and worthlessness. Across disorders, the 29 replicating features can be clustered into three families: less externally oriented language, more self-focused affect, and more somatic content.
blocks.zh: 比较得出了一个中心结论:文本和调查问卷商定哪些症状是共同的,但没有商定哪些症状是连接网络的。 大多数边缘是共享的,然而桥梁症状几乎完全不同,语言强调自我引导的认知,如内疚和无价值. 纵观各种障碍,29个复制功能可以被组合成三个家族:外向语言较少,更注重自我影响,以及更多的体质内容.

blocks.en: Future work will separate symptom endorsement from discussion through stance classification, model within-person change over time, and test transfer to other instruments and platforms.
blocks.zh: 未来工作将通过立场分类、人内部随时间变化的模式以及测试转移到其他仪器和平台,将症状认可与讨论分开。

blocks.en: 6 Limitations
blocks.zh: 6. 限制

blocks.en:
Each user receives one score against one questionnaire administration. Within-person dynamics are not captured; a user’s symptom profile could shift substantially across their posting history, and the pipeline treats this variation as noise rather than signal.
All data come from Reddit. Generalization to other platforms or to clinical populations remains untested. This occurs because, to our knowledge, the eRisk collections are the only public corpora pairing item-level questionnaire responses with social media histories, which validating a text-derived network against a questionnaire-derived one requires.
blocks.zh:
每个用户对一个问卷管理部门得到一个分数。 无法捕捉到个人内部的动态;用户的症状特征可能在其发布历史中发生重大变化,管道将这种变化视为噪音而不是信号。
所有数据来自Reddit. 对其他平台或临床人群的普及仍然没有经过测试。 这是因为,据我们所知,eRisk的收集是公共公司唯一将项目层面的问卷答复与社交媒体历史相配对的,而社交媒体历史将文本生成的网络与调查问卷生成的网络进行校验。

blocks.en: We do not suggest that language-derived bridge nodes can directly guide clinical intervention without rigorous external validation. Bridge centrality here is a structural property of a text-derived network, not a demonstrated treatment target.
blocks.zh: 我们并不认为语言衍生的桥节点可以直接指导临床干预而无需严格的外部验证. 这里的桥梁中心是一个文本衍生网络的结构属性,而不是一个经证明的治疗目标.

blocks.en: At N = 92 N{=}92 with 22 items and four subscales, the ED corpus is underpowered for per-item and per-edge inference; this is quantified via netSimulator and is why ED per-item results are reported as exploratory. Beyond power, the EDE-Q presents a structural challenge that the BDI-II does not, its items span two distinct modalities: behavioral (fasting frequency, diet rules) and cognitive (shape preoccupation, fear of weight gain). Retrieval against a single item phrasing may conflate users who engage in the behavior with users who ruminate about it, conflating distinct symptom mechanisms within one score. A power-matched comparison further indicates that sample size alone does not account for the weaker ED results.
blocks.zh: 在N = 92 N + 92 中,有22项和4个子级,EDbas对每个项目和边缘推论的权力不足;这是通过净模拟器量化的,这也是为什么将ED对每个项目的结果报告为探索性结果的原因。 除了权力之外,EDE-Q还提出了BDI-II没有的结构性挑战,其项目跨越两种不同的模式:行为(快速频率,饮食规则)和认知(形状的专注,害怕体重增益). 对单个项目措辞的检索可能将参与行为的用户与对此进行反响的用户混为一谈,将一个分数内独特的症状机制混为一谈. 与电力匹配的比较进一步表明,单是样本大小并不能说明ED结果较弱。

blocks.en: The anorexia corpus carries binary self-mention of diagnosis-derived labels, not dimensional questionnaire scores.
blocks.zh: 厌食症携带诊断衍生标签的二进制自觉,而不是维度问卷得分.

blocks.en: The pipeline operates on English text only; multilingual generalization is untested.
blocks.zh: 管道只使用英文文本;多语种通用化未经测试。

blocks.en: Self-attribution is operationalized via the LIWC i filter, which has not been validated against human annotations of post-level perspective.
blocks.zh: 自我归属是通过LIWCi过滤器操作的,它还没有根据人类对后级视角的描述来验证.

blocks.en: Bi-encoder weights are used off-the-shelf. Cross-encoder fine-tuning was evaluated and did not improve performance; bi-encoder fine-tuning at scale was not evaluated and could in principle yield gains.
blocks.zh: 双编码器的重量是现成的。 对跨编码器微调进行了评价,没有提高性能;对双编码器微调进行了规模评价,原则上可以产生收益.

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en:
The eRisk corpora are publicly released through the shared task series under data-use agreements that anonymize users. We make no diagnostic or screening claims about specific individuals. Our analyses operate at the population level on aggregated linguistic signal.
Population-level patterns can be misappropriated for individual prediction; the dimensional ρ \rho values reported here are insufficient for individual diagnostic inference. Social media discourse is observational and confounded by platform-specific norms (subreddit topic, posting culture, anonymity); cross-platform generalization should not be assumed. Models that infer mental health states from text raise privacy concerns even when individuals are pseudonymous, and downstream deployment requires careful consideration of user consent and clinical oversight beyond the scope of methodological research.
The applications we consider beneficial are intervention research targeting bridge symptoms, transdiagnostic mechanism discovery, and methodological infrastructure for descriptive psychopathology research using large-scale text data.
blocks.zh:
根据用户匿名的数据使用协议,eRisk corpora通过共享任务系列公开发布. 我们没有就具体个人提出诊断或筛查要求。 我们的分析是在人口一级进行的,涉及汇总的语言信号。
人口一级模式可能被挪用用于个人预测;此处报告的维度 ^ rho值不足以用于个人诊断推论. 社交媒体的言论是观察性的,被特定平台的规范(subreddit主题,张贴文化,匿名)所混淆;跨平台的泛化不应被假定. 将精神健康从文字中推断出来的模式即使个人是假名,也会引起隐私问题,下游部署需要仔细考虑用户的同意和临床监督,超出了方法研究的范围.
我们认为有益的应用是针对桥梁症状的干预研究、转诊机制发现,以及利用大规模文本数据进行描述性精神病学研究的方法基础设施。

blocks.en: 1. Network estimation: EBICglasso ( Friedman et al., 2008 ) via bootnet::estimateNetwork() ( bootnet v1.5.5), default tuning γ = 0.5 \gamma=0.5 2. Correlations: Spearman with pairwise-complete observations, applied uniformly across all four item-level networks. 3. Community detection: igraph::cluster_walktrap() with t = 4 t=4 4. Bridge centrality: networktools::bridge() (v1.5.2), one-step Bridge Expected Influence. 5. Network comparison: NetworkComparisonTest::NCT() v2.2.2 with 1000 permutations and BH-FDR. 6. Centrality: qgraph::centrality_auto() ( qgraph v1.9.8). 7. Stability: bootnet::bootnet() case-dropping, 1000 resamples. 8. Power analysis: bootnet::netSimulator() . ( Foygel and Drton, 2010 ) .
